# Ooze: a green slime 0.84 m across, a soft faceted lump with a lighter crown and two pale eyes;
# it splits when struck (the halves are this model scaled down). Origin: on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Jelly --base-color 0.4118 0.5137 0.3647 --no-slot
material new Crown --base-color 0.5176 0.5882 0.4824 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
material new Pupil --base-color 0.0980 0.1294 0.0980 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Jelly --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0 0 0.3
scale 1 1 0.72
apply --scale
material assign Jelly
active Jelly
mode edit
select face where "pos.z > 0.18"
material assign Crown
select face where "pos.z < -0.2"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.120 -0.360 0.360
scale 0.100 0.060 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.120 -0.360 0.360
scale 0.100 0.060 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export ooze.glb
